COMPONENT_SET: the packet-set manifest declares three components and marks process_guidance REQUIRED at order 1; product-wiring.json binding.packetComponents named only the two conditional official forms, and production-field-map.json carried no componentConditions at all, so the manifest's conditional-generation rule was not in the delivered record. PAGE_ORDER: the assembly loop ran over the resolved SOURCES and appended the composed guidance after it ended, so the required page whose own first heading is READ THIS BEFORE YOU FILE ANYTHING was bound LAST, at pages 4-5, behind both conditional forms. KNOWN_PREFILLS: officialFieldMap() was only ever handed the CANONICAL render's report and ended with 'boundaryWrites: canonicalWrites, boundaryRefusals: canonicalRefusals' — the boundary columns were the canonical columns relabelled, never measured. The boundary petition therefore declared participant.state and participant.zip as written when the page showed 'Wilkes-Barre Township' and nothing after it, and '18702' occurred nowhere.
rows.whatThisLaneChanged: COMPONENT_SET: component identity, ORDER and conditions are now derived from data/record-clearing/legal-design-packet-set-manifests.json (declaredComponents / componentOrderFromManifest / componentConditionsFromManifest) instead of from a constant in the builder; componentSet and the new componentConditions are emitted from it. KNOWN_PREFILLS: the boundary report is passed into officialFieldMap and the boundary columns are measured from it; a mapped write that the boundary render refused is recorded as a boundary refusal carrying the finalizer's own reason, the value the platform HOLDS, and the measurement the refusal was made against; and the builder's write invariant is extended to the boundary fixture in the only form that can hold there — a mapped write must be EITHER written OR recorded as refused, never missing from both.
rows.whyTheTwoValuesAreStillNotPrinted: This lane measured the constraint rather than assuming a drop. AddrState: the form's own /MaxLen is 2 and 'Pennsylvania' is 12 characters; the widget offers 14.21pt of usable width and the value needs 35.23pt at the 6pt readable-font floor. AddrZip: the widget offers 27.85pt and '18702-2214' needs 32.02pt at the same floor (the finalizer records 32). Neither value fits without truncating a participant's own detail or dropping below the readable-font minimum, and this build does neither — printing 'PA' for 'Pennsylvania' or a ZIP+4 with its last four digits cut off would be this lane inventing a fact the record does not carry. So the finalizer's refusals were CORRECT and the defect was the silence around them. The corpus's own prior art agrees: build-census-v1-nd-nonconviction-close-petition-set.mjs states it as 'The blank cannot hold it, so it is left for the participant rather than truncated.'

COMPONENT_SET: binding.packetComponents now names all three in manifest order, guidance first. KNOWN_PREFILLS: the boundary packet's own delivered page now prints 'BLANKS THIS PACKET HOLDS A VALUE FOR AND COULD NOT PRINT' naming 'Address, state': the packet holds Pennsylvania, and 'Address, ZIP': the packet holds 18702-2214 — read back off the PDF text and confirmed on the raster at 2448x3168, legible, no clipping, no overlap. rows.whatWasWrong: All four delivered CR-180s stamped the issuer's privacy banner onto page 3 BELOW the form's own 'CR-180 [Rev. January 1, 2024]  PETITION FOR DISMISSAL  Page 3 of 3' footer, as one clipped line reading 'otection and privacy, please press the Clear This Form button after you have Print', cut at both ends, with the Print/Save/Clear captions overprinting it ('printedthis / the form / form').
rows.rootCause: Not a new defect and not a new root cause. CR-180's AcroForm /Fields array holds one nested root and its footer controls hang below it, so the flat scan in detachFromAcroForm removed nothing, updateFieldAppearances regenerated the banner from its caption, and flatten() stamped it. The finalizer ALREADY classifies these controls SUPPRESS_CONTROL_APPEARANCE and ALREADY calls the detachment; only the nesting defeated it. FIX06 root-caused this shape on CR-409, VF07 confirmed it on CR-400, and the fix is the config flag detachNestedControlFields. Four sibling CR-180 families (ca-1203-41/42/43/4a) already carry it; ca-17b-reduction-set was the last CR-180 family that did not.
